top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A child did not have their hands washed following a diaper change.

top_violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Sitting) (26 TAC §746.4813(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The use zone of a rotating device was deficient as observed during inspection. Another play equipment and a table were less than 6 feet away from the rotating device.    NOTE: This was corrected during inspection. The table and play equipment was moved to comply with use zone.
